name: Standing Bodhisattva with Hands in Anjali Mudra
summary: Standing figure of a Bodhisattva facing proper right with hands raised together in a gesture of adoration. Low sandstone relief from cave 3 (west wall) at Tianlongshan, Shanxi province.
